response.sql: WITH acct_avg AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), region_avg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.avg_amount) AS figure FROM acct_avg aa JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg, r.figure / o.overall_avg AS figure_ratio_to_overall_avg FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.overall_avg;
